title: Slow English Podcast: My Trip to Puerto Escondido! 🇲🇽 Level A2+

header.titleZh: 慢速英語播客：我的埃斯孔迪多港之旅！ 🇲🇽A2+級
header.titleEn: Slow English Podcast: My Trip to Puerto Escondido! 🇲🇽 Level A2+

sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast. A podcast for you to practice slow English listening to learn English while listening to fun stories about my life.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。一個播客，讓您練習慢速英語聽力，一邊聽我生活中的有趣故事，一邊學習英語。

sentences.en: Today I want to tell you about my trip to Puerto Escondido. It's a small city in Wajaka, the south of Mexico. I started my trip in Wajaka City.
sentences.tc: 今天我想告訴你我的埃斯孔迪多港之旅。這是墨西哥南部瓦賈卡的小城市。我從瓦賈卡市開始了我的旅行。

sentences.en: I love how full of vegetation Waka is.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡瓦卡植被茂盛的地方。

sentences.en: Wajaka, getting to see all of the street art and murals, all of the insanely hard work the artists put in to these murals. It was very impressive. Here are some beautiful.
sentences.tc: 瓦賈卡（Wajaka），開始看到所有的街頭藝術和壁畫，以及藝術家為這些壁畫付出的所有瘋狂的努力。這是非常令人印象深刻的。這裡有一些美麗的。

sentences.en: Trees. I loved these pink flowers.
sentences.tc: 樹木。我喜歡這些粉紅色的花。

sentences.en: We went to eat at a cute little coffee shop down an alleyway in Wajaka City for desserts. Of course,.
sentences.tc: 我們去瓦賈卡市一條小巷裡的一家可愛的小咖啡店吃甜點。當然，。

sentences.en: I love sweet bread, an almond cream croissant, and a chocolate filled croissant. That had to be the best croissant I have ever tried. It was scrumptious. So many flowers in Wajaka.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡甜麵包、杏仁奶油可頌和巧克力可頌。那一定是我吃過的最好的羊角麵包。非常美味。瓦賈卡有很多花。

sentences.en: We took our bus.
sentences.tc: 我們搭乘巴士。

sentences.en: We rode all the way to Puerto Gondido, a beach town just 2 hours away from the city. It was such a delight to swim in the ocean again.
sentences.tc: 我們一路騎到了貢迪多港，一個距離市區僅2小時車程的海濱小鎮。再次在大海裡游泳真是太高興了。

sentences.en: We arrived in Puerto Gondido around 5 a.m.
sentences.tc: 凌晨5點左右我們到達貢迪多港。

sentences.en: We head straight to the beach.
sentences.tc: 我們直接前往海灘。

sentences.en: We took a dip in the sea.
sentences.tc: 我們在海裡暢泳。

sentences.en: We head to our apartment. The view was magnificent. Unbelievable that.
sentences.tc: 我們前往我們的公寓。景色非常壯觀。難以置信。

sentences.en: We were able to stay in a room so nice. I felt so privileged to be able to look outside my window and see something so phenomenal. All around the city, there.
sentences.tc: 我們能夠住在一個非常好的房間裡。我感到非常榮幸能夠看到窗外並看到如此驚人的東西。整個城市，那裡都有。

sentences.en: Are so many flowers hanging from trees, on bushes, just everywhere?
sentences.tc: 樹上、灌木叢上、到處都掛著這麼多花嗎？

sentences.en: I recorded them all. I think you must know by now that.
sentences.tc: 我把它們都記錄下來了。我想你現在一定知道了。

sentences.en: I am fascinated with flowers. I think it's so important to find the beauty in everything, the smallest things.
sentences.tc: 我對花很著迷。我認為在一切事物、最小的事物中發現美是非常重要的。

sentences.en: We got pizza for dinner and head to bed. I think you als you also must know by now that.
sentences.tc: 我們晚餐吃了披薩然後上床睡覺。我想你們現在一定也知道了。

sentences.en: I love smoothies. So, every day I make myself a banana smoothie. This time I added some spinach, peaches, and bananas. And for breakfast, I made an avocado toast with ham.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡冰沙。所以，我每天都會為自己做香蕉冰沙。這次我加了一些菠菜、桃子和香蕉。早餐時，我做了酪梨吐司和火腿。

sentences.en: We moved all of our things. My backpack, my yoga mat, my computer and microphones,.
sentences.tc: 我們把所有的東西都搬走了。我的背包，我的瑜珈墊，我的電腦和麥克風。

sentences.en: We were going to rent for one month. Our new place was surrounded by gorgeous things.
sentences.tc: 我們本來打算租一個月。我們的新地方周圍都是華麗的東西。

sentences.en: For example, a luscious tree, a mango tree with mangoes hanging from the branches. and the cutest little pineapple I have ever seen. For breakfast,.
sentences.tc: 例如，一棵甘美的樹，一棵芒果樹，樹枝上掛著芒果。還有我見過的最可愛的小鳳梨。早餐，。

sentences.en: We made shakshuka with avocado, even a starf fruit tree with the sweetest fruit. It was so nice to have starf fruit whenever.
sentences.tc: 我們用酪梨製作了shakshuka，酪梨甚至是結有最甜果實的楊桃樹。無論何時都能吃到楊桃真是太好了。
